description.value: Western Bike Company is a premium cycling component dealer and specialist service shop located in Cumberland, BC — Vancouver Island's legendary mountain biking hub. The shop focuses on custom wheel builds and RideWrap frame protection installation, partnering with high-end brands such as Chris King, NOBL Wheels, Maxxis Tires, and Sapim Spokes. Touring cyclists passing through Cumberland for its hundreds of kilometres of single-track, road, and gravel routes will find a knowledgeable team oriented toward quality builds and bike protection rather than general repair.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms a physical showroom at 2712 Dunsmuir Ave, Cumberland, BC, operating as a premium cycling component dealer with RideWrap application and custom wheel-building services; the FAQ page explicitly states the full address and describes the Cumberland location near world-class riding. The OSM tags record limited weekday-only hours and a check_date of 2025-09-25, while the website's © 2026 footer corroborates the business is currently active. Neither the website nor OSM tags provide evidence for most touring-cyclist amenities (pump, walk-in repairs, washrooms, etc.), as the shop's stated focus is specialized services requiring advance inquiry.
concerns: OSM opening hours are very limited (Mo-Fr 10:00-14:00 only, closed weekends); this restricts touring-cyclist utility significantly and warrants confirmation.
OSM address field omits city and postal code; website FAQ confirms full address as 2712 Dunsmuir Ave, Cumberland, BC V0R 1S0 — no conflict, but OSM record is incomplete.
Phone number (+1-236-255-3136) appears only in OSM tags and was not found in the fetched website content; could not be confirmed via website.

Business is oriented toward premium MTB components and appointment-based specialized services (RideWrap, wheel building); no evidence of general repair, pump access, or other typical touring drop-in services.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The shop is a legitimate bicycle business in Cumberland, a major cycling destination, but its specialization in premium components, wheel building, and RideWrap rather than general touring support — combined with very restricted OSM hours (Mo-Fr 10:00-14:00 only, closed weekends) — makes its utility for passing touring cyclists unclear without further on-the-ground verification.

wow_evidence: premium cycling component dealer and specialist service shop located in Cumberland
